title: ZEUS Product Guide
content:
ZEUS Product Guide · Page 1
Section 1 describes the AEGIS Edge Gateway.
AEGIS is the ZEUS edge gateway appliance for on-premises
deployment. Each unit carries 8 SFP+ ports rated at 10 Gbps each
and a sustained throughput of 40 Gbps under the standard
benchmark profile. Median latency measured at full 40 Gbps
load is 1.8 milliseconds.
List price is USD 12,450 per unit, effective 2024-03-04. The
price includes a 36-month warranty and 24x7 support. The
Severity 1 support response commitment is 30 minutes from the
first acknowledged ticket.
Shipping weight is 6.4 kg and the unit draws 210 watts at full
line-rate load.
Section owner: Ravi Chandrasekhar, Vice President of Product.

ZEUS Product Guide · Page 2
Section 2 describes the HELIOS Analytics Suite.
HELIOS is the ZEUS fleet analytics and predictive maintenance
suite. It is licensed in annual seat subscriptions. A HELIOS
subscription covers up to 250 monitored gateways and is priced
at USD 2,900 per seat per year.
HELIOS requires AEGIS gateway firmware 4.1.0 or later. Gateways
running firmware older than 4.1.0 are not supported and are not
covered by the 24x7 support commitment.
Telemetry is retained for 400 days on the standard plan and
for 1,460 days on the regulated plan. The product reached
general availability on 2024-06-11.
Section owner: Ravi Chandrasekhar, Vice President of Product.
